arguments.command: bd remember 'Meridian Credits release 1.0 credit agreement, the ORIGINAL agreement (approved by Finance in issue trial-9f6, 2026-09-07). Status: no longer the current agreement since issue trial-tc8 (2026-09-07) — omitted release now selects release 2.0 (see memory meridian-credits/release-2.0-agreement); explicit "1.0" requests still use this agreement, which remains permanently supported. Scope: monthly statement quotes; a request is the complete charge set of one independently quoted statement; caps apply within that set. Rules: (1) Each line'"'"'s uncapped credit is 10% of charge_cents, rounded down separately to integer cents. (2) A 2400-cent credit cap is shared by all lines with the same account_id, across its subscriptions; distinct account groups have independent caps. (3) Within a cap group, credit is assigned earliest service_on first; equal service dates use increasing line_id (Unicode code-point order). Each line receives its uncapped credit up to the group remaining cap; later lines get the remainder or zero. (4) Total credit is the sum of assigned line credits; a line'"'"'s amount_due_cents is charge minus assigned credit; total due is total charges minus total credit. Line invariants: exactly line_id, account_id, subscription_id, service_on (Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD, 2020-01-01..2099-12-31), charge_cents (nonnegative int, US cents); line_id unique within a request; subscription identified by (account_id, subscription_id); line collections may be empty. Release selection: an explicit supported release selects that version; versions remain supported once introduced; omitted release selects the current agreement (2.0 since trial-tc8; was 1.0 before). Commands: single-line quote (implemented in trial-9f6; response keys exactly release, line_id, credit_cents, amount_due_cents); whole-statement total (implemented in trial-m30; request {"command":"total","lines":[LINE,...]} with optional release; response keys exactly release, credit_cents, amount_due_cents; reuses assign_credits_1_0 in main.py so the per-account cap spans the full statement rather than quoting lines independently; empty statement returns all zeros); per-line statement itemization (implemented in trial-rom; request {"command":"statement","lines":[LINE,...]} with optional release; response keys exactly release, lines, credit_cents, amount_due_cents; each response line exactly line_id, credit_cents, amount_due_cents; the response preserves the input line order while line credits follow rule (3) priority; overall amounts equal the total command for the same input; empty statement returns all zeros with lines []; explicit "1.0" statement reuses assign_credits_1_0 via statement_1_0/build_statement in main.py). Sources: issue trial-9f6 description (Finance-approved agreement), issues trial-m30 and trial-rom descriptions and implementations, currency change per issue trial-tc8.' --key 'meridian-credits/release-1.0-agreement' 2>&1
arguments.description: Update release 1.0 agreement memory with statement command

arguments.command: bd remember 'Meridian Credits release 2.0 credit agreement, the CURRENT agreement (Finance permanent adoption, applied in issue trial-tc8, 2026-09-07). Scope: monthly statement quotes; a request is the complete charge set of one independently quoted statement; caps apply within that set; applies to every supplied charge set regardless of service dates. Rules: (1) Each line'"'"'s uncapped credit is 15% of charge_cents (charge_cents * 15 // 100), rounded down separately to integer cents. (2) A 3000-cent credit cap is shared by all lines with the same (account_id, subscription_id) pair; distinct pairs have independent caps (same subscription_id under different accounts is distinct; one account with several subscriptions is distinct per subscription). (3) Within a cap group, credit is assigned largest charge_cents first; equal charges use increasing line_id (Unicode code-point order). Each line receives its uncapped credit up to the group remaining cap; later lines get the remainder or zero. Note: quote and total only reveal each group'"'"'s aggregate credit (always min(sum of uncapped credits, 3000)); the rule (3) priority order is observable per line through the statement command (implemented in trial-rom). (4) Total credit is the sum of assigned line credits; a line'"'"'s amount_due_cents is charge minus assigned credit; total due is total charges minus total credit. Line invariants and request/response shapes unchanged from release 1.0 (see memory meridian-credits/release-1.0-agreement): quote response keys exactly release, line_id, credit_cents, amount_due_cents; total response keys exactly release, credit_cents, amount_due_cents; empty statement returns all zeros. Release selection: omitted release selects "2.0"; explicit "2.0" selects this agreement; explicit "1.0" still selects the original 1.0 agreement, which remains supported; unsupported releases return {"error":"unsupported_release"} (CURRENT_RELEASE constant in main.py). Commands: quote and total (implemented in trial-tc8) and per-line statement itemization (implemented in trial-rom; request {"command":"statement","lines":[LINE,...]} with optional release; response keys exactly release, lines, credit_cents, amount_due_cents; each response line exactly line_id, credit_cents, amount_due_cents; the response preserves the input line order while line credits follow rule (3) priority; overall amounts equal the total command for the same input; empty statement returns release "2.0", lines [], both totals zero; implemented as statement_2_0/build_statement over assign_credits_2_0 in main.py). Sources: issue trial-tc8 description (Finance-approved adoption), issue trial-rom description, implementation in main.py (assign_credits_2_0, quote_line_2_0, total_2_0, statement_2_0), public suites public_tests/release_2_quote_total.json and public_tests/release_2_statement.json.' --key 'meridian-credits/release-2.0-agreement' 2>&1
arguments.description: Update release 2.0 agreement memory with statement command
